payload.title: IMP-PROV-01: Absorb the accepted provider catalog into Providers Catalog
currentProgress: CTR-PROV is accepted and Factory-consumed: PR #1350 merged exact head b3e5edc9a as dd63993ea with selected CI SUCCESS or intentional SKIPPED, terminal idea/plan/task/review, and changed paths limited to pkg/services/providers root contracts/characterization tests plus minimal coverage and ownership/package-target baseline registration.

The Providers root now publishes additive ListProviders/GetProvider/Execute and identity/catalog/execute contracts. Nested catalog and execution implementations, Wire/root/initializer wiring, and transitional workers/provider deletion remain out of CTR-PROV scope.

Standardized Providers catalog publication under packages/model-providers and transitional Workers-owned catalog/registry/conductor behavior are terminal foundations. Concrete adapter migrations (Claude/Codex/Pi/OpenCode/Agy and leased Gemini/Kiro/Cursor moves) stay behind IMP-PROV-02.

IMP-WRK-04 agent runner is prerequisite-ready (IMP-WRK-03 + CTR-PROV) but is lower preference while Providers Catalog/Execution absorption is the high-unlock Providers track. IMP-WRK-07 remains deferred because workers/services/hosted_logic is Linear polling, not Hosted Runner remote execution.
No active implementation owner holds Providers, Wire/root, OpenAPI/generation, CLI manifests, coverage manifests, or ownership-inventory leases.
payload.requestedOutcome: Implement IMP-PROV-01 by absorbing the accepted standardized provider catalog into the parent-private Providers Catalog subservice at pkg/services/providers/internal/services/catalog so the published Providers root ListProviders/GetProvider slices are fulfilled by that private catalog rather than a second inventory. Preserve deterministic enumeration order, identity canonicalization/aliases, capability facts, availability/prerequisite/readiness outcomes, and actionable probe/unknown/unavailable failures already owned by the accepted catalog foundations and CTR-PROV contracts. Keep catalog descriptors detached and Providers-owned; do not expose Workers provider registry/conductor types, concrete adapter packages, Petri/JavaScript types, or transport/UI concerns through the catalog boundary. Construction must remain inert. Treat pkg/services/workers/provider/** catalog-facing transitional sources as read/absorb sources only; do not delete the transitional Workers provider tree, relocate concrete adapters, or implement IMP-PROV-02 execution/registry/conductor absorption in this packet. Do not start IMP-PROV-03..06 adapter migrations, IMP-WRK-04 agent runner, IMP-WRK-07 hosted runner, IMP-RUN-03, IMP-SES-06, IMP-MOD-03, OpenAPI or generated API artifact changes, CLI manifests/root/run/server behavior, pkg/root, pkg/wire, pkg/initializer, UI code, or broad functional-test topology. Any ownership-inventory, package-target-manifest, or Go coverage-manifest updates must register only the new Catalog package paths and remain lease-minimal. Require focused catalog unit/characterization tests for deterministic list/get, unknown identity, unavailable/prerequisite-blocked facts, and probe failures; gofmt; vet/lint; architecture/ownership checks; and make verify-fast.

payload.title: Reassess Providers and Workers successors after IMP-PROV-01 catalog absorption
payload.requestedOutcome: Review the accepted IMP-PROV-01 implementation, Factory review, changed paths, tests and CI, then reconcile the queue. Compare owner-disjoint successors against live leases: IMP-PROV-02 execution/registry/conductor absorption, IMP-WRK-04 agent runner, deferred IMP-WRK-07 hosted runner, IMP-RUN-03 dispatch planning, IMP-SES-06 runtime opening, and IMP-MOD-03 assets. Prefer IMP-PROV-02 when its leases are free because it unlocks adapter migrations and stronger Providers Execute fulfillment; otherwise choose the smallest high-unlock Workers or owner-local packet that does not collide. Keep concrete adapter migrations behind IMP-PROV-02.
